**Example 1 (2024-10-09)** - This looks like a bullish reversal from a dip
- History: Price bottomed at 60.29 on Oct 1st, then rallied
- Sentiment: Mixed but ending positive (last few days: 1.00, 0.67, 1.00)
- Model forecasts: Around 61.70-65.36 for first 6 days, then 62.53, 61.70, 62.63...

Looking at the discrepancy:
- Day 1-3: Model too low (61.73 vs 62.01; 64.50 vs 65.00; 64.00 vs 64.62)
- Day 4: Model close (65.36 vs 65.97) - about 1 point off
- Day 5-6: Model accurate
- Day 7-8: Model too low (62.42 vs 62.28 - actually model was slightly too high here, but close)


- Day 9-10: Model significantly underperformed, missing the 61.76 vs 61.95 difference and 62.25 vs 62.28 alignment
- The model consistently underestimates prices, particularly in the early days of the forecast
- Sentiment positive (1.00, 0.67) suggests model lacks full market optimism
